name: Failed Jobs
description: Number of failed Good Job jobs
code: Bord.metric :failed_jobs, label: "Failed Jobs", value: GoodJob::Job.where.not(error: nil).count

name: Pending Jobs
description: Count of pending Good Job jobs
code: Bord.metric :pending_jobs, label: "Pending Jobs", value: GoodJob::Job.where(dispatched_at: nil).count
